weekly_plan.text:
Mon - Lower (knee-friendly strength; patellofemoral load management; target RPE 6-7)
Tue - Upper (scapular kinematics + low-irritability pulling) + VO2 (Assault Bike; 8-12 min > VT2; RPE 7-8)
Wed - Recovery (parasympathetic bias; tissue tolerance; 20-30 min Z1)
Thu - Lower (hinge + posterior chain; hip-dominant; avoid deep knee flexion)
Fri - Upper (press + anti-rotation core; limit shoulder abduction if symptomatic)
Sat - Conditioning (aerobic base; 30-45 min Z2)
Sun - Rest (sleep extension; low-load mobility only)

workout.name: Spanish Squats
cues: Sit back into the strap and keep chest tall.

workout.name: Right Clamshells
cues: Lie on your left side, knees bent 45 degrees.
Keep right hip stacked - do not roll back.
Lift only the right knee with feet touching.
Cue: "Open the book." Feel glute med burn.

workout.name: Dumbbell RDL
cues: Soft knees, then freeze the bend.
Push hips back; keep dumbbells on your legs.
Stop at mid-shin - no floor contact.
Drive up with glutes. Cue: "Stretch firmly, squeeze hard."

workout.name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Neutral or underhand grip if shoulder pinches.
Depress shoulders first, then pull.
Drive elbows to back pockets.
Stop at collarbone. Cue: "Long neck, low elbows."

workout.name: Goblet Squat
cues: Elbows inside knees; chest tall.
Pause at the bottom, then stand fast.

workout.name: Push-Up
cues: Body straight, squeeze glutes.
Chest to floor, drive up fast.

workout.name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Hinge hard; snap hips.
Bell to chest height, arms relaxed.

workout.name: Supported Dead Hang
cues: Keep toes on the floor or a box.
Let gravity open the spine gently.

workout.name: Incline Dumbbell Curls
cues: Bench 45-60 degrees; arms hang behind torso.
Keep elbows pinned back - no drift forward.
Cue: "Elbows behind the ribs."

workout.name: Face Pulls
cues: Rope at face height, thumbs toward you.
Pull rope to nose; split hands outside ears.
Cue: "Thumbs back, chest out."
